profiles.summary: Mainnet still runs v0.16.5 with revision MONAD_TEN. Release v0.16.6, identical to v0.16.7 in the x86 emitter, adds a compiled path for a literal shifted by a variable amount and a cache that skips repeated memory bound checks; both were transcribed or read and give the specified results. The opcode battery, pmdiff, pmdiff2 and the mined swap checks were rerun and repeat the results of OPCODES.md.

deltas.delta: The current facts page lists Monad mainnet and testnet at v0.16.5 with revision MONAD_TEN on 2026-11-24. The endpoint reports the client version as Monad/unknown.

emitter.cpp is byte identical at v0.16.6 and v0.16.7. Against v0.16.5 it adds shift_literal_by_non_literal (lines 5253-5326), a branchless CLZ, a register move helper, and in touch_memory (about line 6301) a per stack element record of the memory size already checked, so a second MLOAD or MSTORE through the same non-literal offset in one basic block skips the bound check.

The shared uint256 library changed between v0.16.5 and v0.16.6 only in countl_zero, which now scans all four words without an early exit; the new form returns 192 - 64i + clz(word i) for the highest nonzero word i and 256 for zero, which is the same result. runtime/math.hpp is identical at both tags.

profiles.summary: MIP-8 changes storage gas and the database encoding of storage, and leaves the value of every slot keyed by its full 32 bytes in execution. Committed PoolManager storage of 22 live pools satisfies the cross-slot liquidity invariants, and 5,837 multi-bit alias reads and 4,509 transient ones returned zero.

deltas.delta: In execution the page index is used only by PageTracker for warm and cold gas and the page write and growth charges; get_storage and set_storage stay keyed by the full slot. Under MIP-8 SSTORE gives no refund.

In the database a slot is read as page[slot & 0x7F] of the page stored under slot >> 7, and a block commit loads each touched page from the parent state once, applies every changed slot of that page, and writes the page back.

profiles.summary: Nothing new for gas, native currency or tokens. The pmdiff differences at 25 million gas are the same 21 and 20 scripts as before and stop at the heavy swaps already explained by gas.

Nothing new for precompiles or system contracts in this cycle's reading. The public audits and the bug bounty material of the last two years name consensus, transaction pool and reserve balance faults, none of which changes an opcode result.

deltas.delta: The Code4rena audit of September to October 2025 lists four high findings (legacy transaction gas price discount in block policy, EIP-7702 transactions that time out rounds, a wrong affordability check, an order dependent EIP-7702 status mismatch) and seven medium ones, all on consensus, the transaction pool, networking, storage trim and receipt encoding.

A researcher reported in January 2026 that the reserve balance check read a code hash after other transactions of the block, and the fix moved the check to original balances. It concerns the 10 MON reserve of externally owned accounts.

profiles.summary: The endpoint reports mega-reth v2.2.3. mega-evm v1.7.4 is now the newest release and its changelog lists tooling, CI and documentation only; its lock still pins revm 40.0.3, revm-interpreter 37.0.3 and ruint 1.19.0. The battery and both pmdiff sets were rerun and match Ethereum on every vector and script.

deltas.delta: mega-evm v1.7.4 changes no execution file according to its changelog; Cargo.lock at v1.7.3 and on main both pin ruint 1.19.0 and revm 40.0.3. stateless-validator 2.1.0 still pins mega-evm v1.7.3 and its own lock resolves ruint 1.17.2.

deltas.delta: A post-mainnet fix in mega-evm pull request 293 (merged 2026-05-11) stopped the CREATE2 storage gas wrapper from slicing initcode out of memory before expansion, an out of bounds read. The PoolManager bytecode contains no CREATE or CREATE2.

profiles.summary: SALT stores the full address and slot in every entry and compares it on lookup, so a bucket hash collision cannot merge two slots. Committed storage of 14 pools satisfies the cross-slot invariants, and the alias probes for persistent and transient slots returned zero.

deltas.delta: shi_search walks the linear probe sequence of a bucket and compares the stored plain key with the requested one; direct_find checks the plain key of a cached location before returning it.

profiles.summary: Rex6 changes the order of storage gas and compute gas charging and returns forwarded gas to the parent when a call halts on the compute gas limit. The Rex6 page says no network has scheduled it, while the mega-evm v1.7.3 changelog says Rex6 was scheduled on mainnet; which one holds was not confirmed.

deltas.delta: Rex6 makes every storage-affecting opcode charge storage gas before its body and record compute gas once afterwards, and when a CALL exceeds the compute gas limit it halts the calling frame with the forwarded gas returned. The page states that Rex6 is frozen and not yet scheduled on any network.

profiles.summary: The BlockSec security test of MegaEVM, the stateless validator and SALT reports four high and one medium issue, all denial of service or commitment faults; none changes the value an opcode or a storage read returns.

deltas.delta: BlockSec lists unbounded TSTORE use, cheap KZG computation, a crash from a KZG precompile gas fault and high-cost opcode loops as high denial of service issues, and a wrong parent node index in SALT bucket subtree updates as medium (fixed). Guardian audited MegaEVM in July 2026 with a private report.

cleared.check: Monad v0.16.6 and v0.16.7 shift_literal_by_non_literal with destructive_mov_stack_elem_to_bounded_rax at bound 256 (lead L-574), transcribed into Python and compared with SHL, SHR and SAR
cleared.result: 959,394 cases without a mismatch: every shift 0 to 299 and nine shifts above 2^32, for the five literals the build shifts by a variable amount (1, 2^256-1, the BitMath tables at BitMath.sol:22 and 40-42, and a bytes4 mask), 34 edge values and 1,000 random values, under all three operand locations of the shift. The two loads never leave the 96 byte window and the carry load supplies exactly the bits the per-lane vpsllq or vpsrlq drop. The literals were found by a basic block scan of the built runtime (bbscan.py), which finds four SHL and two SHR sites of this shape.

cleared.check: Which v0.16.5 path handles a literal shifted by a variable amount before v0.16.6
cleared.result: v0.16.5 shift_by_non_literal returns the literal for 0, and for all ones under SAR, and otherwise moves the literal into an AVX register and takes shift_avx_reg_by_non_literal, the path the 17,434 mined Monad swaps of OPCODES.md already exercised. v0.16.6 sends the same case to the new routine above.

cleared.check: Monad v0.16.5 inline paths for SIGNEXTEND with a literal index, BYTE with a literal and with a variable index, and LT, GT, SLT and SGT as deferred comparisons (lead L-575), transcribed and compared with the specification
cleared.result: No mismatch in 1,926,792 cases: SIGNEXTEND indexes 0 to 39 and above 255 at the AVX and general register locations, BYTE indexes 0 to 39 and values with any of the upper 192 bits set at the memory, general register and AVX locations, and comparisons with literal and non-literal operands, including x = 2^256-1, x = 2^255-1, a literal zero and operands one apart across the sign bit. The cmp then sbb chain skips only the leading zero limbs of a literal and the JUMPI tests the carry or the sign and overflow flags of the last limb.

cleared.check: Which Monad compiled instructions leave the inline code and call the shared library (lead L-575)
cleared.result: SDIV, SMOD, DIV, MOD, ADDMOD and MULMOD call runtime::sdiv, smod, udiv, umod, addmod and mulmod unless the divisor or modulus is a literal (folding, or a power of two rewritten as a mask). The interpreter's instruction table calls the same runtime functions, so the battery and the targeted vectors run through eth_call test the code that blocks use. The built PoolManager has no SDIV or SMOD with a literal divisor and no MULMOD with a literal power of two modulus; FullMath.mulDiv uses mulmod(a, b, not(0)), which is not a power of two and goes to the library.

cleared.check: Monad v0.16.6 touch_memory record of an already checked offset
cleared.result: The skip applies only to a non-literal offset element whose earlier check in the same basic block covered at least the same read size; memory of a frame never shrinks, so the earlier check still holds, and the skipped path still reloads the memory base pointer from the context. Read only; no transcription.

cleared.result: All 5,837 reads returned zero and every s read back its value; the transient storage variant gave 4,509 zero reads. The source agrees: execution values are keyed by the full slot and the page is used only for gas.

cleared.check: Public Monad audit and bounty material of the last two years for faults that change opcode results or storage values
cleared.result: The Code4rena report, the January 2026 reserve balance report and the open OOB read issue in range_get_triedb_async concern consensus, the transaction pool, the reserve check and an FFI bound; none lets an ordinary account change what the PoolManager computes or holds.

cleared.check: MegaEVM and SALT security test and later fixes
cleared.result: The BlockSec findings are denial of service and one SALT commitment index fault, fixed; the REX4 audit fixes in pull request 230 concern resource limits, gas detention and SELFDESTRUCT growth accounting; pull request 293 fixes a CREATE2 read, an opcode the PoolManager never runs. None changes an arithmetic, jump, memory or storage result for the PoolManager.

leads.question: Read or transcribe the v0.16.5 x86 code generation for MUL (mul_optimized and mul_with_bit_size), EXP, the SIGNEXTEND paths with a variable index, and the runtime helpers for KECCAK256 and memory copies, and after mainnet adopts v0.16.6 rerun swaps.py and replay.py on blocks after the upgrade.
leads.why: These are the parts of the compiled path no simulated call reaches and no reading has covered; FullMath and SqrtPriceMath multiply on every swap, and v0.16.6 adds new shift and memory paths that only mined blocks run.

leads.question: Run invariants.py over every pool of the 19,402 Initialize logs, not only the 22 pools active in a 1,757 block window, and add the position invariant (liquidityGross of a tick equals the sum of position liquidity that names it).
leads.why: The page layer check covers pools that traded recently; idle pools with old pages are where a merge fault from an earlier release would remain.

leads.question: Is Rex6 active on MegaETH mainnet? The Rex6 page says no network has scheduled it, while the v1.7.3 changelog says it was scheduled on mainnet and testnet. If it is, rerun pmdiff and pmdiff2 after activation.
leads.why: Rex6 changes when a call halts on the compute gas limit and returns forwarded gas to the parent, which changes what a deep hook or token call returns to the PoolManager near the limit.

leads.question: Run slotalias.py and invariants.py for Tempo, Arc and HyperEVM, which lead L-587 also names; this unit's run covered Monad and MegaETH only.
leads.why: Single bit tests cannot see a multi-bit fold, and these networks were not probed this cycle.

leadResults.answer: The routine was transcribed with its rodata layout (SHL window {7,0,0,0}, 0, value at line offset 32 with the mask at offset 0; SHR and SAR window value, fill, {fill0, fill1, 7, 0} with the mask at offset 80) and the bound 256 clamp at all three operand locations. 959,394 cases, including every shift 0 to 299 for 1, 2^256-1, both BitMath tables and a bytes4 mask, match SHL, SHR and SAR. In v0.16.5 the same shape went through shift_avx_reg_by_non_literal after moving the literal to a register. Mainnet still runs v0.16.5.

Inline in v0.16.5: comparisons as cmp and sbb with deferred flags, SIGNEXTEND by a literal index, BYTE, shifts and the literal special cases. Library calls: SDIV, SMOD, DIV, MOD, ADDMOD and MULMOD with non-literal or non power of two divisors, through the same runtime functions the interpreter calls. The inline paths were transcribed and matched the specification in 1,926,792 cases at the edges asked for. MUL and EXP code generation remain unread and are carried as a new lead.

Execution keys values by the full slot and uses the page only for gas. 5,837 multi-bit alias reads and 4,509 transient ones returned zero, the cross-slot invariants of 22 live pools hold over 1,335 ticks, and eth_getStorageAt equals extsload on 132 tick record slots, one at a page edge. The page container and commit merge were read and are consistent.

Cleared for MegaETH: SALT compares full keys, and the alias probes and invariants found no fold. Monad is covered under L-576. Tempo, Arc and HyperEVM were not probed by this unit and are carried as a new lead.
